<TEI xmlns='http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0'><seg xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" type="excerpt" xml:id="ex088052025-05-2616-02-05" status="finalized"> <lb n="15a6"/> des na sangs rgyas la yul dus kyis chod pa <expan>med</expan> de rnal 'byor ba'i rtogs pa bsaM gyis mi khyab pa'i phyir te | de ltar yang <rs type="work" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:3772">rnaM 'grel</rs> las |
       <quote><lg>
            <l>gzung dang 'dzin pa'i shes pa ni ||</l>
<l>               ma dag skye bo las yin te ||</l>
            <l><expan>rnal 'byor</expan> rtogs pa bsam mi khyab ||</l> 
            <l>phra srabs <expan>la sogs</expan> ngo bo'i phyir |</l>
         </lg></quote>
         zhes <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:unnamed_reference">bla ma mkhas pa</rs> <note type="gloss"><rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:3839">gtsang</rs> <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:3807">'bre</rs><note type="editorial"/>Alternatively: gTsang pa 'bre sgur (ID:3872)</note> gsung |</seg></TEI>
